metadata.title: test: add comprehensive unit tests for secrets detection plugin (#2872)
metadata.author: omorros

description:
## 🔗 Related Issue                                                                                                         
  Closes #2872

 ---                                                                                                                         

  ## 📝 Summary
  Add comprehensive unit tests for the `plugins/secrets_detection` module, expanding coverage from 7 tests to 97.

  **Tests added for:**
  - All 8 regex patterns (aws_access_key_id, aws_secret_access_key, google_api_key, slack_token, private_key_block, jwt_like, 
  hex_secret_32, base64_24)
  - `SecretsDetectionConfig` model (defaults, overrides, disabling patterns)
  - Helper functions: `_iter_strings`, `_detect`, `_scan_container`
  - All 3 plugin hooks: `prompt_pre_fetch`, `tool_post_invoke`, `resource_post_fetch`
  - Edge cases: empty inputs, deep nesting, multi-pattern matches, examples cap at 5

  **Bug fix:** Fixed `AttributeError` in `prompt_pre_fetch` redaction path — `payload.name` → `payload.prompt_id` (line 196 of
   `secrets_detection.py`).

  ---

  ## 🏷️ Type of Change
  - [x] Bug fix
  - [ ] Feature / Enhancement
  - [ ] Documentation
  - [ ] Refactor
  - [ ] Chore (deps, CI, tooling)
  - [ ] Other (describe below)

  ---

  ## 🧪 Verification

  | Check                     | Command         | Status |
  |---------------------------|-----------------|--------|
  | Lint suite                | `make lint`     | ✅ ruff + black pass |
  | Unit tests                | `make test`     | ✅ 97/97 passed |
  | Coverage ≥ 80%            | `make coverage` |        |

  ---

  ## ✅ Checklist
  - [x] Code formatted (`make black isort pre-commit`)
  - [x] Tests added/updated for changes
  - [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
  - [x] No secrets or credentials committed

  ---

  ## 📓 Notes (optional)
  Verified locally with Python 3.11.7. The original integration test (`test_resource_post_fetch_receives_resolved_content`) is
   preserved unchanged.
